description: Subscribe to a recurring DataHub dataset (time-based access, on-chain payment with the plan's USDC price). While active, every update of the dataset can be fetched with datahub_download — no per-download payment. Renewing extends from the current expiry. Spending caps apply.

book_id.description: Id of a dataset that offers a subscription plan. datahub_search reports one under "subscription"; datasets without a plan must be bought with datahub_buy instead.

name: datahub_subscribe
